evals.prompt: Lint wiki/entities/npc/varn.md — it has broken wikilinks to [[High Eyrie]] and [[the-sentinels]], missing summary frontmatter, and the basename uses snake_case. Fix everything.
evals.expected_output: One lint repair loop: links resolved to existing owners, summary added, basename renamed to kebab-case, and any incomplete template work completed through the owner skill using grounded canon; when novel content is needed, ground it with wiki-query and wiki-context-pack before an appropriate task-specific subagent handles it.

assertions.text: Runs wiki lint before making edits
Broken wikilinks resolved to existing vault pages, not deleted or converted to plain text when a match exists
Missing summary frontmatter added with a default value, not left missing
Basename renamed from snake_case to kebab-case
If required template sections are empty, reads linked canon and uses the page owner skill to complete them rather than leaving a blank scaffold
Grounds novel content in established wiki fact with wiki-query and wiki-context-pack before delegation
Final page-scoped lint is clean with no findings

evals.prompt: Run a full vault lint. Report what you find but don't fix anything.
evals.expected_output: A full lint result with aggregate counts and every finding, with no files modified; identify next.path as the first file for manual repair.

assertions.text: No files are modified — report only, no edits or renames
Runs wiki lint, uses aggregate counts and next.path as the first manual repair target
Findings grouped by check type with counts per category
Reports every finding in the aggregate output
Skips _archive, _raw, templates, and _meta directories

evals.prompt: There are two pages that look like duplicates: wiki/entities/faction/the-passage.md and wiki/entities/faction/passage-guild.md. Lint and resolve them.
evals.expected_output: Reads both pages, applies Check 14 duplicate resolution — merge, digest, or differentiate — with manual merge, not a script. Wikilinks rewritten vault-wide to canonical target.

assertions.text: Reads both files fully before deciding merge/digest/differentiate verdict
Uses manual merge via Edit/Write tools, not a script or automated merge command
Canonical page absorbs the secondary's title as an alias
Wikilinks vault-wide rewritten from secondary name to canonical name
Does not create a redirect stub — aliases absorb the old name per Check 14 rules
Updates index.md and hot.md after the merge

evals.prompt: A faction page has sections in the wrong order, content outside the template, and a missing DM thesis. Run lint and repair the page completely.
evals.expected_output: One lint repair loop: consults the faction contract, preserves and relocates existing content, and completes the DM thesis through faction-design with grounded canon.

assertions.text: Sections reordered to match wiki/templates/contracts/faction.yml
Content outside template sections preserved — relocated to nearest matching section or flagged, not deleted
Missing DM thesis is completed with substantive, canon-grounded content through faction-design
Reruns lint only after every template job is substantive
Consults the template contract before repairing the page

evals.prompt: Lint wiki/entities/item/snakewood.md. Frontmatter type is creature (same as live wiki/entities/creature/snakewood.md) but the file is under entities/item.
evals.expected_output: Kind home first: move to wiki/entities/creature/snakewood.md from frontmatter type, then audit the creature page. Do not apply the item template while it sits under entities/item.

assertions.text: Reports misplaced_entity and moves the page to wiki/entities/creature/snakewood.md before template or Vale
Does not audit or repair the page as an item while it remains under entities/item

evals.prompt: Lint wiki/entities/place/carpenters-slip.md. The page has valid frontmatter and a few linked canon references, but its required place sections are blank. Repair it completely.
evals.expected_output: Reads the linked canon, loads place-design, grounds novel content with wiki-query and wiki-context-pack, delegates the content work to an appropriate task-specific subagent, treats the completed delegated result as the source of truth, integrates it once, and reruns lint until clean. It does not leave empty headings, independently draft competing place prose while delegation is active, or report the page as repaired after structural edits alone.

assertions.text: Reads linked entities and source material before writing
Uses place-design to complete the page's required place jobs
Grounds novel content with wiki-query and wiki-context-pack before using a task-specific subagent
Does not independently draft competing place prose while the delegated content subagent is working; integrates the completed delegated result once as the source of truth
Leaves no blank required place sections
Final lint is clean only after the page is substantive and actionable

evals.prompt: Lint a quest page with missing plot content. The user asked for linting, not plot creation.
evals.expected_output: Skips plot creation and continues every other lint repair, finishing when no actionable non-plot findings remain.

assertions.text: Skips plot creation without an explicit user request
Continues and completes non-plot lint repairs

evals.prompt: Continue lint repair for wiki/entities/place/carpenters-slip.md after a place-design subagent was assigned the blank place sections. The subagent has not returned yet. Finish any disjoint structural findings now, but do not write competing place prose; when its result arrives, integrate that result once and rerun lint.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the delegated place-content handoff authoritative: performs only disjoint structural lint work while the subagent is active, waits for or reads the completed grounded result, integrates it once, and does not invent replacement place prose.

assertions.text: Runs lint and identifies disjoint structural findings separately from the delegated place-content work
Does not draft or overwrite competing place prose while the content subagent is active
Treats the completed delegated result as the source of truth, integrates it once, and reruns scoped lint

evals.prompt: Run the maintenance loop on a scoped page with one registered deterministic finding and one semantic owner-level finding.
evals.expected_output: Complete findings are reported; the registered fixer runs through the existing CLI, the semantic finding returns to its artifact owner, and the affected scope reruns until clean or a specific blocker is reported.

assertions.text: Exposes every configured finding in the selected scope, including the deterministic and semantic findings
Runs only the existing registered deterministic fixer through wiki lint fix and preserves its CLI scope contract
Returns the semantic finding to the named artifact owner with bounded page, canon, and lint evidence
Reruns wiki lint on the affected scope after repair and closes only on a clean result or reports a path/rule/owner-specific blocker
Does not report success merely because prose was written or structural edits completed

evals.prompt: Repair a scoped page with one registered deterministic finding and one semantic finding owned by place-design. Run the deterministic fixer once, hand off only the semantic section with lint evidence, and resume the same worklist after the owner returns.
evals.expected_output: Runs the existing deterministic fixer through its CLI contract, sends a bounded semantic packet, integrates the owner's returned artifact evidence once, reruns only the affected lint scope, and closes only on clean lint or a specific blocker.

assertions.text: Runs the registered deterministic fixer once before semantic owner work.
Bounds the place-design packet to the affected page/section, linked canon, template, and lint evidence.
Requires the owner return to name the artifact/section, addressed finding, and completion evidence before resuming the worklist.
Reruns lint on the affected scope and reports a path/rule/owner blocker when the return is incomplete or lint remains.
